# Infinite Nets

> Infinite Nets is an immersive virtual reality (VR) cricket batting simulator for the Meta Quest 3 headset. It lets cricketers practise batting at home, year-round, by facing realistic pace and spin bowling using a bat-handle accessory. Built for grassroots cricket: individual players, schools and clubs.

## What it is
- Product: Infinite Nets — a VR cricket batting trainer / simulator
- Platform: Meta Quest 3 (standalone VR headset)
- Hardware: uses a bat-handle accessory that clips to the Quest controller for realistic shot-making
- Price: free to download
- Audience: grassroots cricket — beginners to experienced players, plus schools and clubs

## Key features
- Face all bowling variations, from pace to spin
- Gamified, structured drills (good length, pull and drive, spin, and more) with high-repetition practice
- Every session is tracked: balls faced, runs, strike rate, fours, sixes, and a broadcast-style wagon wheel showing shot placement
- An online player portal (in development) for following stats and trends over time
- Designed as a practical answer to winter weather and limited access to nets, bowlers and facilities

## Why it exists
Good cricket practice is hard to come by: nets are scarce, winters are wet and dark, and finding bowling at the right standard is difficult. Infinite Nets gives players unlimited, high-quality batting practice on demand, at home, whatever the season.
